name: Theory of Yarn Structure
description: Basic characteristics of fibers, fiber blends and yarns; arrangement of fibers in yarns; pores in yarns; helical model of fibers in yarns; relationship among yarn count, twist, packing density, and diameter; radial migration of fibers in yarns; mass irregularity of staple fiber yarns; hairiness of staple fiber yarns; tensile mechanics of fiber bundles and yarns; bending mechanics of yarns; structure and mechanics of plied yarns.
